findings.summary: IC power pin U1.13 (VCCA12SSRX4) has no DC path to a power rail (net 'HUB_1V2')
findings.description: Pin U1.13 (VCCA12SSRX4) is type=power_in on net 'HUB_1V2'. Graph walk (≤2 hops, rejecting capacitor edges, accepting resistors≤1Ω, inductors, ferrite beads, bridged solder jumpers) did not reach a named power rail. The pin is likely AC-coupled to ground only — the IC will not power up reliably.
findings.recommendation: Verify the schematic for this pin: the DC route must go through a conducting element (direct wire, 0Ω resistor, inductor, ferrite bead, or bridged solder jumper) — not a capacitor. If the intent was to tie VCC through an LC filter, add the missing inductor or 0Ω in series.

text_annotations.text: USB3-ONLY HUB OVER SFP+ — ELECTRICAL DRAFT

Optical interface NOT YET CONNECTED: resolve Rx.Detect, LFPS, idle and disconnect behavior.
SFP_TD/RD and SSTX0/SSRX0 are intentionally separate nets until that circuit is qualified.

No USB2 data routing: all ten hub D+/D- pins and all USB-A D+/D- contacts are NC.
NC does not remove the hub's need for the specified power rails and configuration.

PENDING: power/clock/port qualification, pin 40 disposition, SSREXT value, reset/VBUS policy,
VBUS/input protection, signal ESD layout/testing, SFP controller/filter, firmware and module qualification.

Pin 20 = GND; pin 21 = float; pin 57 = NC (normal mode).
Source: supplied VL813.pdf pp.8–11; SFP contacts: SFF-8431 Table 3.
Pin names / critical dispositions checked; operation NOT verified.
SFP POWER FILTERS AND MANAGEMENT — DRAFT
TX supply branch
RX supply branch

SFF-8431 D.17 / Figure 56: target R_damp + inductor DCR + 22uF ESR = 0.5 ohm.
R1/R2 = 0.43 ohm candidate; nominal total about 0.494 ohm at 15kHz. Transient qualification pending.

100nF input/output bypass; bulk capacitor connects to GND THROUGH damping resistor. Separate TX/RX inductors.
OPEN ISSUE: ideal-feed SPICE stress (0 to 600mA in 10us, no module C) dips to 3.03V nominal. Not qualified for that load.

Status pullups: 4.7k (sections 2.4.1 / 2.4.4 / 2.4.6).
SDA/SCL: 4.7k initial, 100kHz and bus C <= 100pF; verify rise time.
Pullups use module-side supplies; external controller must not back-power them.

J6 provides access, NOT link control. Pin 2 is a voltage reference, not a 5V input.
TX_DISABLE relies on the module pullup: transmitter stays disabled until driven low.
RS0/RS1 policy and recovery controller remain pending; no permanent enable strap.
VL813 POWER, DECOUPLING AND CLOCK — CANDIDATE CIRCUIT

U1.18 feeds HUB_3V3; U1.39 drives L3; U1.37 senses HUB_1V2.
U1.40 remains unresolved (datasheet lists DC12FB; published project leaves it open).
Supply-pin bypass allocation is stored on each C20-C35 as Placement target. Values and layout require qualification.
Clock and bias

Clock: 25MHz / 22pF candidates; crystal CL, ESR, drive and parasitics remain unqualified. SSREXT value remains TBD.
U12 monitors HUB_3V3, CT open: 12-28ms delay. J9 requests reset; C38 now bypasses U12, replacing the old reset RC.
Does not monitor HUB_1V2 or implement optical recovery. Core-rail sequencing, clock startup and reset timing require tests.
J7 feeds hub, four switched ports and SFP regulator. Connector rating, input protection and total budget remain pending.
FOUR CURRENT-LIMITED PORTS — GANGED ENABLE AND FAULT

23.2k / 1%: 1.024-1.208A current-limit range (TI Table 2); design load 0.9A per port.
Fault outputs combine at USBHOC1_N; OUT rails remain independent. R18-R21 discharge output bulk.

U6 inverts USBHPE1_N. R14 defaults request OFF; R15 holds EN low with U6 unpowered (VCC=0).
HOC2 is pulled inactive; unused charging-enable pin 42 is NC. Verify normal/gang firmware behavior.
Require 5.0-5.2V at board under load. Input surge/budget, capacitor selection, ramps and thermal tests pending.
SFP REGULATED SUPPLY — 3.3V / 2A CONVERTER

U7 is independent of the hub 3.3V LDO. Both SFP filters share its output.
MODE 32.4k selects forced PWM / 2.5MHz / VSET / discharge. Pin 9 deliberately OPEN selects 3.3V.
EN follows local 5V. This sheet does not implement commanded module power cycling.

PG is test access only: it senses the regulator output BEFORE L1/L2. It does not prove module voltage or link readiness.
PG is undefined below VIN=1.8V; no reset or TX-enable logic is driven from it.
Nominal 10nF soft start is about 3.26ms. Module inrush, filter resonance, rail skew and brownout remain test items.

Source: TI TPS62902 SLVSFM1A pp.3,5-6,10-12,18-21,45-46; Coilcraft XGL4020 Doc1529. Capacitor selection pending.
Native RPJ/XGL4020 footprints checked. DC allocation: <=0.10 ohm per filter branch; 50mV low-frequency disturbances.
These are design constraints, not measured performance. Module electrical and optical compatibility remains unqualified.
PORT 1 — J2
PORT 2 — J3
PORT 3 — J4
PORT 4 — J5
FOUR USB3 PORTS — SIGNAL-LINE ESD PROTECTION

One four-channel bidirectional TVS per port. Pins 1/2 protect TX; pins 4/5 protect RX. Both GND pins connect.
TX protection is on the connector side of C1-C8. No connection to VBUS, D+ or D-. No supply pin is required.

Pads 10/9/7/6 have no internal signal path. Route copper across pad pairs 1-10, 2-9, 4-7, 5-6.
Identical net labels do NOT provide an internal bridge. Place the array at the connector, with continuous pair routing
and short ground returns. Avoid stubs and keep incoming ESD paths away from protected traces.

TI TPD4E02B04 SLVSD85B pp.3-5,15,24-25. Bidirectional +/-3.6V; not suitable for 5V VBUS protection.
0.25pF typical / 0.33pF max per line at 0V, 1MHz, 25C. PCB/connector parasitics add to this.
Component ESD ratings do not establish board immunity. USB eye/return-loss and system ESD tests remain required.

top_issues.summary: IC power pin U1.13 (VCCA12SSRX4) has no DC path to a power rail (net 'HUB_1V2')
top_issues.description: Pin U1.13 (VCCA12SSRX4) is type=power_in on net 'HUB_1V2'. Graph walk (≤2 hops, rejecting capacitor edges, accepting resistors≤1Ω, inductors, ferrite beads, bridged solder jumpers) did not reach a named power rail. The pin is likely AC-coupled to ground only — the IC will not power up reliably.
top_issues.recommendation: Verify the schematic for this pin: the DC route must go through a conducting element (direct wire, 0Ω resistor, inductor, ferrite bead, or bridged solder jumper) — not a capacitor. If the intent was to tie VCC through an LC filter, add the missing inductor or 0Ω in series.
